note: The OLG provides comprehensive coverage of transitional benefits (called TBA — Transitional Benefits Alternative) across multiple dedicated pages. The TBA Overview page covers: eligibility criteria (Potential TBA Amount must exceed Monthly Federal Allotment when TAFDC closes due to income), benefit calculation (BEACON recalculates excluding the TAFDC grant), ineligibility for TBA (non-compliance with TAFDC/SNAP requirements, IPV disqualification), and the 5-month transitional period — all aligning with FNS Section 727 requirements. The TBA Case Maintenance page covers reporting exemptions during the TBA period and dual participation prevention. The Reclassification page explains automatic BEACON conversion from PA to NPA and TBA qualification checks when cash closes. The Verifications at Case Maintenance page confirms TBA households are not required to report or verify changes. BEACON procedures are detailed throughout, including how the system automatically determines TBA eligibility, sets the TBA indicator, and manages the certification period.
